label: 14 Peer table
info: One peer-table story: State snapshot + feed, fanned to debug panes and (optionally) Dashboard 2.0 tables. Debug works with core Node-RED alone; the ui-table nodes need `@flowfuse/node-red-dashboard` — install it, deploy, open /dashboard/peers.

name: Peer table — debug + dashboard
info:
The peer table is Connection-owned and built entirely from received traffic — nothing here is configured. Fields stay null until a message carrying them arrives.

Snapshot path: every 2s (or Snapshot now / sysid 1) → State snapshot → raw debug, a readable layout debug, and a Dashboard table (replace).

Feed path: State feed (all peer-table events, including the flight-dynamic *-changed edges) → events debug and a rolling Dashboard log (append, capped at 200).

Debug panes work with core Node-RED alone. For /dashboard/peers:

    npm i @flowfuse/node-red-dashboard

SITL bind 127.0.0.1:14550 → 14551.

Absorbs former examples 28 (inspector) and 29 (dashboard-only).
